subject: Security-driven deployment preference — next steps and evidence list
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Thompson <kelly.thompson@mediassist.com>, procurement@mediassist.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: security constraints and deployment preference (MediAssist)

Hi Kelly / procurement team,

Thanks again for the 8:30 PT sync. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we can scope an accurate proposal: 

Summary of constraints you raised:
- PHI scope: patient clinical notes + scheduling metadata; stored for up to 7 years per MediAssist retention policy.
- Required legal controls: BAA required before any production data; SOC 2 Type II report required as part of diligence.
- Audit needs: ability to export per-request audit logs for 12 months, and a documented incident response SLA.

Deployment options we discussed (please confirm preference or constraints):
1) Hosted API + BAA: quickest to ship; we will provide a signed BAA and SOC 2 report, but keys/tokens live in our hosted control plane. Works if you accept our data handling and retention controls.
2) Dedicated (reserved) capacity: customer-dedicated GPU pool with isolated tenant; better for strict isolation and predictable throughput; still managed by Redwood but with stronger tenancy boundaries.
3) Private VPC / on-prem: fully customer network-controlled deployment (VPC peering or on-prem package) — strongest for regulated environments where customers require network isolation and bring-your-own-key.

Action items I propose now: 
- Kelly: confirm which deployment option you want us to prioritize for proposal (Hosted/BAA, Dedicated, or Private VPC/on-prem) and whether MediAssist legal will sign a standard BAA or needs redlines.
- Naomi: share SOC 2 Type II report and sample BAA + SLA draft (attached).
- Aditya/Marissa: prepare high-level cost delta between Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for first-year run-rate (include setup/one-time).

Timeline: if we get preference and any legal redlines by end of this week (Fri 2027-03-12), we can send a tailored proposal + SOW estimates by Wed 2027-03-17.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (SOC2 summary), hipaa-sample-ba-agreement.docx (sample BAA), mam-deployment-sla-draft.pdf (SLA + retention appendix).

Thanks — happy to hop on another call if useful.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai

[Attachment: hipaa-sample-ba-agreement.docx]

From: Kelly Thompson <kelly.thompson@mediassist.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@mediassist.com, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: security constraints and deployment preference (MediAssist)

Hi Naomi — thanks for the clear notes and attachments. Quick answers from our side: 

- PHI scope confirmed: clinical notes + scheduling metadata + referral info. We do not plan to send images.
- BAA: legal will need to review; they typically push some modest redlines around subprocessors and breach notification timelines.
- SOC 2: please send the full SOC 2 Type II report (not just summary) and a one-page narrative on how you surface audit logs (format, retention, export). We’ll attach to our vendor security review.

Deployment preference: we want a written justification for Hosted + BAA vs Dedicated vs Private. Our security lead is inclined to start with Dedicated capacity for a pilot if the Dedicated isolation meets our audit log/export needs — that limits vendor management overhead but keeps stronger tenancy than shared hosted. If Dedicated doesn't meet some of our criteria, we'll evaluate Private VPC.

Can you confirm:
1) For Dedicated, are audit logs available for export in CSV/JSON and can we get 12 months retention by default?
2) For Hosted+BAA, do you offer key separation or CMK options?
3) For Private, what is typical lead time and on-prem footprint (min GPU count / node size)?

Procurement: I looped procurement for visibility — they'll reach out on contract timeline once legal provides redlines.

Kelly Thompson
Head of Security & Privacy
MediAssist Health
kelly.thompson@mediassist.com
[Quoted text omitted]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: security constraints and deployment preference (MediAssist)

Naomi / Marissa — quick internal note before we respond to Kelly: 

- SOC2: Naomi, we should provide the full SOC 2 Type II report (redacted sensitive customer info) and a 1-page audit-log export guide (include sample schema). I’ll pull the latest from Compliance & redact as needed.
- Dedicated: default retention for logs is 90 days in platform; we can offer 12 months as an add-on for Dedicated (requires config + storage cost). Confirm pricing delta.
- Hosted with CMK: we support customer-managed keys in certain enterprise tiers; need to check for this account/region.
- Private/on-prem: typical lead time 8–12 weeks for on-prem install + orchestration and validation; min recommended cluster is 4 x A100 (or equivalent) for reasonable throughput.

I'll put together a short matrix (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with one-line pros/cons + rough delta in cost + typical lead times. Marissa can help with the SOW draft and cost figures.

-Aditya
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kelly Thompson <kelly.thompson@mediassist.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: security constraints and deployment preference (MediAssist)

Hi Kelly — thanks for the fast reply and the deployment preference guidance. Naomi / Aditya and I discussed and here's the follow-up we can share with your team today: 

Short summary matrix (first pass):
- Hosted + BAA: time-to-prod 2–3 weeks after BAA signed; SOC 2 Type II available; CMK available in enterprise tier (subject to contract). Audit logs available via console API; default retention 90 days, exportable CSV/JSON.
- Dedicated: pilot time-to-prod 4–6 weeks; tenancy isolation with tenant-specific GPU pool; can enable 12-month audit-log retention (additional storage cost, included in SOW).
- Private VPC / On-prem: lead time 8–12 weeks; full network isolation and optional HSM integration; recommended min cluster 4 x A100 for production pilot.

Requested next steps (we'll act once we have your preference):
1) Naomi: send full SOC 2 Type II and audit-log guide (ETA EOD today).
2) Marissa/Aditya: attach a 1-page cost delta and a short SOW skeleton (ETA Tue 2027-03-16).
3) Kelly/Procurement: send any standard BAA redlines (if possible) so we can review earlier.

If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical deep-dive with your security team next week to walk through audit logs and key management options.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
